blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls with an English-speaking guide. In Guaraní, Iguazu means “big water”: some 275 cascades plunge into the Devil’s Throat gorge, creating a dramatic contrast with the calm river above. View the falls from the walkways and enjoy the panorama of the entire system.

**Optional excursions (additional cost)**

**Macuco Safari — USD 130 per person.** Travel about 3 km through the jungle in an open jeep, walk to the river and take a speedboat ride close to the falls.

**Bird Park — USD 50 per person.** Explore large rainforest aviaries where brightly coloured birds fly freely.

**Helicopter over Iguazu Falls — USD 3,666 per helicopter (1–5 people).** A private 35-minute flight over the falls and national park.

blocks.text: Travel across the Tancredo Neves Bridge for a guided excursion to the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. Walkways lead through the national park directly above and below the cascades, with spectacular views of the Devil’s Throat and the rainforest-framed falls. From the viewing platforms, see the water plunge into the gorge and rainbows form above the spray. The Argentine-side trails offer a close-up perspective that complements the sweeping panoramic views from the Brazilian side.
